runtime_state_contract.rule: This registry declares actor identity, authority and operating bounds. It does not own live scheduler, execution, health, PR or observation state.

actors.purpose: Verify governance, full regression and staged consumer smoke on each relevant exact head and publish an attributable observation.
actors.reason_running: Event-driven verifier; actual run state is owned by GitHub Actions runtime.
actors.wake_condition: GitHub push or pull_request event supplies a repository head
actors.retirement_condition: A versioned replacement verifier is registered and this actor is explicitly retired.

lifecycle.last_observation: Live verifier state is not committed here; query GitHub Actions runtime.

actors.purpose: Verify exact-head Steward integration structure with a base-owned checker after bootstrap, without claiming live merge authorization.
actors.boundary: Structural evidence only. The workflow cannot replace the Main Steward's live review, incident, race, expected-head merge, or post-merge checks. The bootstrap PR publishes no trusted Steward status because its base does not yet contain this workflow/checker.
actors.reason_running: Event-driven verifier; actual run state is owned by GitHub Actions runtime. Trusted PR verification begins only after this workflow and checker exist on the base branch.
actors.wake_condition: GitHub pull_request_target event from a base containing the trusted workflow/checker, or push to main.
actors.retirement_condition: A versioned replacement structural verifier is registered and this actor is explicitly retired.

lifecycle.last_observation: Live verifier state is not committed here; query GitHub Actions runtime.

actors.purpose: Select and bound only currently justified N0TE construction work, then become dormant when construction is stable.
actors.boundary: Temporary build harness machinery; not N0TE and not the persistent cloud coordination plane.
actors.reason_running: No bounded construction increment is selected. SONG-01-AB-LOUDNESS-BIAS-01 merged as ab1bb8f87a3d5b021d352a215302b14114312021 after exact-head cross-platform proof, and governance issue #191 closes only that receipt while full REQ-SCOPE-010 remains open.
actors.wake_condition: Canonical current_state selects a bounded dependency-ready increment or contradictory evidence requires explicit reactivation.
actors.retirement_condition: A superseding build harness is explicitly registered.

lifecycle.last_observation: SONG-01-AB-LOUDNESS-BIAS-01 is implemented, exact-head verified and merged; governance closure returns SONG-01 to PRESERVED with construction STABLE/DORMANT without selecting adjacent product work.
lifecycle.next_wake_condition: Global product reselection from fresh live main selects one dependency-valid unowned increment.

actors.purpose: Operate the single cloud-side TellMeN0TE + N0TE coordination plane across durable authority and connected providers without multiplying independent watchers.
actors.boundary: Persistent coordination plumbing around TellMeN0TE, ChatGPT and N0TE; not N0TE and not the N0TE build harness.
actors.reason_running: Registry declares the actor; actual scheduler and execution state must be observed from ChatGPT automation runtime.
actors.retirement_condition: A proven replacement coordination plane owns the same authority surfaces and this actor is explicitly retired.

lifecycle.last_observation: Live cloud-controller state is not committed here; query ChatGPT automation runtime.

actors.purpose: Execute or delegate one exact active construction receipt when explicitly invoked; never operate as an independent always-on lane.
actors.boundary: Temporary/on-demand build executor; not N0TE and not permanent coordination.
actors.reason_running: Registry declares the optional executor; actual enabled/execution state must be observed from ChatGPT automation runtime.
actors.wake_condition: Explicit build-harness delegation against a fresh exact head and active receipt.
actors.retirement_condition: A proven replacement build executor is explicitly registered.

lifecycle.last_observation: Live build-worker state is not committed here; query ChatGPT automation runtime.

orphan_policy: Any autonomous actor without a registered parent, reporting path, purpose, bounded failure policy, allowed mutations, wake/retirement conditions and observation contract is a governance failure.
terminal_policy: No actor may create successor construction merely to remain active. Live runtime state belongs to its runtime owner, not this registry.
